text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(If I can run like I did at the Satsuki
Sho...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(But what if things turn out like they did
at the
Kikuka Sho?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I honestly don't know how things will
turn out.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(At the very least, this bonehead
believes in me.)
